assessment: The Synthesis is traceable to the upstream accepted results and targeted taxonomy-design literature. It correctly preserves non-exclusive methodological roles, heterogeneous classification axes, and domain/boundary uncertainty; it does not collapse these into a single existing standard. K0006 is explicitly marked as an evidence-constrained synthesis rather than a taxonomy claimed to exist in one source. The ontology-versus-facet separation is a legitimate constructive integration of the upstream constraints, while U0001-U0003 retain non-systematic coverage and the need for empirical iteration/MECE testing. No unsupported factual claim or concealed design judgment requiring repair was identified.
